'''2000 DecipherCon Race for Alderaan''' was a Star Wars CCG side event held in Kissimmee, Florida on 7 October 2000. [[Clay Ramey]] won it. It is known from Charlie Herren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1322">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-11-the-bad-player-goes-to-deciphercond1322/ the-bad-player-goes-to-deciphercon], DeckTech (Charlie "Bad Player" Herren, 11 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-11-the-bad-player-goes-to-deciphercond1322/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[DecipherCon 2000]].

* '''Date:''' 7 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Kissimmee, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Race for Alderaan Constructed]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Clay Ramey]]
